name: Initial Response to Right-to-Know Request
description: Response granting, denying, partially granting, extending, or seeking clarification on a written records request; a non-response is deemed a denial.
deadline: within five (5) business days of receipt of the request
quote: The Open Records Officer’s initial response time shall not exceed five (5) business days from the date the written request is received by the Open Records Officer, in accordance with applicable law.
